name: Taskboard
description: Processes on this machine in the bottom dock, with the agent or workspace that owns each one.

settings.label: Update speed
settings.description: How often the page asks for a new snapshot. It pauses by itself when the dock is hidden.

settings.label: Show Windows apps
settings.description: Runs a small Windows helper through WSL interop. Off shows only the Linux environment PiCode runs in.

settings.label: Tell me when an agent stays above 80% CPU
settings.description: At most one Inbox note per agent every 30 minutes. Off by default.
